answer: Quadratic cost scaling at the nadir of token distribution: an attacker renting n identities must lock n² stake, so cost explodes while payout stays linear. The cipher of on-chain deposits makes each fake identity independently verifiable and slashing-exposed. Honest miners reach the opal tier cheaply because their stake is real and singular. Break-even: beyond ~7 identities, marginal revenue drops below marginal stake cost, so farming turns net-negative.
